title: The Unsmashable Snowman
notes: Detective-cast (Detective Boys, Conan, Haibara, Agasa, Kogoro, Ran) omitted by convention, except where their prop actions matter to the physical evidence (the kids' own snowman and detective badges are kept as object nodes since they are load-bearing clues, but the kids themselves are not modeled as person nodes). The episode opens with several minutes of unrelated serialized Black Organization subplot (Mizunashi Rena, Hondou Eisuke, Vermouth) that has no bearing on the snowman murder and is not represented here. Old cases/ file correctly identified Itabashi Kazuya as the culprit -- no culprit discrepancy. However the old file's single clue/event pair conflates two distinct physical snowmen into one: Itabashi actually used ONE salt-hardened snowman/snowball to conceal Sakuko's body and roll it into the lake (which then melted and was gone), and built a SECOND, separate decoy snowman afterward -- using stolen fruit/face parts cannibalized from the Detective Boys' own snowman -- to make it look like nothing had happened to his 'in-progress' project. The Detective Boys' own hidden badges (planted in their snowman as a prank) ended up inside this second, rebuilt snowman, which is the actual physical proof of the reuse trick, not proof of where the body was hidden. This file models both snowmen as separate object nodes. Motive: Sakuko was in love with Itabashi, who loved fellow student Onoue Asaka; out of jealousy Sakuko manipulated Asaka, an accomplished skier with no snowboarding experience, into snowboarding, causing a leg injury that (per Sakuko's own drunken confession, overheard by Kiyama and Itabashi) she had engineered on purpose. Itabashi killed Sakuko to avenge Asaka and deliberately kept Kiyama from finding out, believing Kiyama would have taken more drastic revenge himself. case_type: murder.

clues.desc: Detective Boys' badges, hidden inside their own snowman as a prank, are instead heard jingling inside Itabashi's rebuilt snowman -- proves he dismantled and reused their snowman's parts.
Genta gets a nosebleed and tastes salt after falling near Itabashi's snowman spot, unlike ordinary snow elsewhere -- reveals that patch was chemically hardened with salt.
Autopsy finds lake water, not ordinary water, in Sakuko's stomach, yet no route existed for her to have drowned at the lake itself -- someone must have brought lake water into a room to drown her.
Sakuko is found without gloves, hat, or goggles despite an apparent snowboarding accident -- inconsistent with someone actually dressed to snowboard, suggesting the gear was added after death.
